    src: inventory-lb.conf.j2
    dest: /etc/nginx/sites-available/inventory-lb.conf

    src: /etc/nginx/sites-available/inventory-lb.conf
    dest: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/inventory-lb.conf
    state: link

  ansible.builtin.command: nginx -t
  changed_when: false

  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    name: nginx
    state: restarted
    enabled: true
